items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Another thing I witnessed was we went to play a job with, his name was Google Eyes, his real name was Joe August. And he took a five piece band and we went to Alabama to play.

ctx.x: So during that time, I mean, it seems like a transition period as far as like the Civil Rights Movement, were you involved in that directly or actively in any of that?

Well, while the Civil Rights Movement is going on, I can tell you some things that I witnessed some of the first riots, set-ins, and different other things that was going along with Dr. King and other people marching in different places, you know. So we had to, we were in different places when it happened, such as in Jacksonville, Florida. And I regret the day that I got, I took pictures of the first people being hit in the head and crammed into buses and denied a place to eat and all this kind of stuff. I took…
So what did that say to you?
